name: clodable
description: Shape your app with Claude, publish when you're happy. Saves every change to your draft on GitHub, publishes in one click, keeps your live data safe.

friendlyRows.title: Plain-language activity
friendlyRows.description: Show Claude's steps in plain words ("Updated the Hero section") instead of tool names. Developers may prefer to turn this off.

autoSave.title: Save after every reply
autoSave.description: Save Claude's changes to your draft on GitHub after each reply.
